messages:
alex: Noticed an abnormal spike in structured-output rejects for fncall hooks overnight (eu-central). Roughly +22% vs baseline. Many are labeled as 'missing_property' and a subset as 'json.parse_error'. Users are getting fallback responses.

lee: Where did you pull the numbers from?

alex: The structured-validation view in Grafana + quick query in clickhouse:
```sql
SELECT route, validation_code, count() AS cnt
FROM invokes
WHERE ts > now() - 24h
GROUP BY route, validation_code
ORDER BY cnt DESC
```
Top routes: /v1/tools/email_parse, /v1/tools/webhook_bridge. validation_code mostly 'missing_property'.

infra-bot: [NOTIFY] elevated structured_validation_rate on service:fncall (eu-central) id=4280123460

taylor: Two quick hypotheses: 1) recent model update changed output shape, 2) a client SDK change removed optional fields. Do we have sample payloads captured?

alex: We have a handful in the validation-samples bucket (PII scrubbed). Example payload: 
```json
{"tool":"email_parse","result":{"subject":null,"body":"Got this...","attachments":[]}}
```
Validator expected subject:string non-null.

nora: UX concern: console shows these as FAIL and highlights a big red "Rejected by schema" badge. That's alarming to customers. We should surface a quieter state: "Response shape mismatch (attempted correction)" and provide a collapsible view with the diff.

lee: On policy side, we need a telemetry field to unify treatment across billing/console/routing. Suggest adding: validation_code (enum), validation_outcome (reject|soft_fail|coerced), correction_attempted (bool), correction_result (success|failed|none).

taylor: Agree. Also recommend a per-route control to allow soft_fail for specific tool types. We can default soft_fail off. For the canary, flip soft_fail for /v1/tools/email_parse only.

alex: What should billing do when we soft_fail and then hit fallback? Current flow: customer billed for entire request on fallback model. Some customers disputed charges when fallback was triggered by a small schema quirk.

billing-bot: Suggestion: add charge_tag = validation_fallback for these invocations so finance can report. Not changing billing immediately.

lee: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Add telemetry fields (backwards compatible), 2) Add soft_fail flag and control plane toggle per-route, 3) Canary soft_fail on email_parse for 5% traffic for 72h, 4) Capture N=200 sample diffs with scrubbed inputs, 5) Update console copy and add example viewer.

taylor: Technical note on implementation: validator currently emits only boolean pass/fail. We'll change to return a structured ValidationResult: 
```json
{"code":"missing_property","message":"subject missing","repairs":[{"type":"inferred_default","field":"subject","value":"(no subject)"}],"will_coerce":true}
```
The runtime will then decide action based on route policy (reject vs soft_fail).

alex: We should also track auto_repair_success and repair_false_positive rates so we don't introduce silent corruption. Add metrics: validation.auto_repair.count, validation.auto_repair.success_ratio.

nora: Console UX: two visual states are important: 1) Completed w/ correction (badge: yellow, text: "Completed with structured correction"), 2) Rejected (badge: red). For Completed w/ correction show the patched payload and explain why we patched plus a link to a best-practice.

lee: One open question: when we mark validation_outcome=soft_fail do we expose the original failed payload to the customer in the activity log or only the corrected one? Privacy + confusion concerns.

taylor: Expose both in the sample viewer but flag which was shown to the model. Scrub PII and redact headers.

infra-bot: Ticket created INF-2522 "validation-result-structured-fields + soft_fail per-route toggle" assigned to @lee @taylor. PR checklist: migration notes, metric names, sample capture location.

alex: OK. I'll prepare the sample set and draft console copy. @nora can you draft the two microcopy variants and sample viewer UX?

nora: Yep, will post drafts in #eng-platform-docs. My initial line: "Completed with structured correction — the platform repaired a missing field to preserve your experience. Click to see details."

lee: I'll scope the control-plane endpoint (PATCH /routes/{id}/policy) and the canary logic. Need to confirm RBAC and audit log entries for toggles.

taylor: Will update the validator to emit ValidationResult and wire correction metadata into invoke telemetry. Planning to start a branch and open an RFC PR.

alex: Great. Let's review progress in the weekly sync. If any of you see customer escalations about billing for these fallbacks, ping billing-bot to tag examples.

billing-bot: Created tag validation_fallback for charge disputes and a small runbook: /docs/billing/validation-fallback-handling

alex: Thanks all. Quick decision: manual opt-in for soft_fail at first?

lee: Manual opt-in + canary only. No silent global flips.

nora: Agreed. Customers should opt in or be notified via console when their route is toggled.

alex: Sync ended.
